tasks.summary_pl: Wielomian $W(x)$ z param. $m$, przes. przez $(0,0)$. Pierwiastki? (suma)
tasks.summary_en: Polynomial $W(x)$ with param $m$, shifted through origin. Roots? (sum)
tasks.statement_en: Given is the polynomial $W(x)=x^3-3mx^2+(3m^2-1)x-9m^2+20m+4$. The graph of this polynomial, after translation by the vector $u=[-3,0]$, passes through the origin of the coordinate system. Find all the roots of the polynomial W.

tasks.notes: Answer is a union of intervals for parameter m

tasks.summary_pl: 6 kostek: dokł. 2 jedynki, 3 szóstki, suma parzysta. P?
tasks.summary_en: 6 dice: exactly two 1's, three 6's, even sum. P?
tasks.statement_en: Consider a roll of six dice, each of a different color. Calculate the probability of the event that the result of the roll simultaneously satisfies three conditions: exactly two dice show one pip; exactly three dice show six pips; the sum of all the pips obtained is even.
